test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 46,800 is divided among A, B, C and D in such a way that the ratio of the combined share of A and D to the combined share of B and C is 8 ∶ 5. The ratio of the share of B to that of C is 5 ∶ 4. A receives Rs. 18,400. If x is the difference between the shares of A and B and y is the difference between the shares of C and D, then what is the value of (x – y) (in Rs.)?
solution: __Shortcut Trick__ Total Ratio parts (A+D) + (B+C) = 8 + 5 = 13 units. 13 units = 46800 → 1 unit = 3600. Combined shares: (A+D) = 28800 and (B+C) = 18000. B : C = 5 : 4 → 9 units = 18000 → B = 10000, C = 8000. Given A = 18400 → D = 28800 − 18400 = 10400. x − y = (A − B) − |C − D| = (18400 − 10000) − (10400 − 8000) = 8400 − 2400 = 6000. **∴ The correct answer is ₹6000.** **__Alternate Method__** **Given:** Total sum = ₹46,800 (A + D) : (B + C) = 8 : 5 B : C = 5 : 4 A = ₹18,400 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/377c9002e8216b6775c127b41c96dfac8dd6b7d7888a3f8a37fa47792ea39a29.png] **Calculations:** ⇒ Share of (A + D) = [8 ÷ (8 + 5)] × 46800 = (8/13) × 46800 = 8 × 3600 = ₹28,800 ⇒ Share of (B + C) = [5 ÷ (8 + 5)] × 46800 = (5/13) × 46800 = 5 × 3600 = ₹18,000 ⇒ Share of B = [5 ÷ (5 + 4)] × 18000 = (5/9) × 18000 = 5 × 2000 = ₹10,000 ⇒ Share of C = [4 ÷ (5 + 4)] × 18000 = (4/9) × 18000 = 4 × 2000 = ₹8,000 ⇒ Share of D = (A + D) − A = 28800 − 18400 = ₹10,400 ⇒ x = Difference between A and B = |18400 − 10000| = ₹8,400 ⇒ y = Difference between C and D = |8000 − 10400| = ₹2,400 ⇒ Value of (x − y) = 8400 − 2400 = ₹6,000 **∴ The correct answer is ₹6000.** **__Additional Information__** Ratio Distribution When a quantity Q is divided in ratio a:b, the parts are [a/(a+b)] × Q and [b/(a+b)] × Q. Difference and Modulus The difference between two values p and q is usually taken as the absolute value |p − q|, which is always non-negative. Compound Ratios To solve for multiple variables, ensure they are linked by a common term or common total sum parts. 8e:T25cb,
